sloka: इक्ष्वाकूणाम् कुले देवि सम्प्राप्तः सुमहानयम् ।अनयो नयसम्पन्ने यत्र ते विकृता मतिः ॥२-१२-१९॥
transliteration: ikṣvākūṇām kule devi samprāptaḥ sumahānayam ।anayo nayasampanne yatra te vikṛtā matiḥ ॥2-12-19॥

translations.english: O queen, till now you had a moral sense. With your mind debased (now), a very great immorality has infected the Ikshvaku race.
